non_claims: This audit does not run exact factorization on new rows.
A set-valued feature containing the true line is not a public line predictor unless it chooses one line before exact factorization.
Replay-failure rows are mechanism evidence only and are not counted as ECDLP recoveries.

summary.interpretation: Simple public feature dictionaries do not yet predict fresh preserving target-67 lines. Repeated subset features are useful diagnostics, but they are ambiguous or replay-failure-only in these windows.
